Class ModifierKeyMouseButton

public ModifierKeyMouseButton(ShapeMouseButton modifierKey, float mouseMoveDeadzone = 25, float mouseWheelDeadzone = 3, bool reverseModifier = false)

Parameters

modifierKey ShapeMouseButton

The mouse button to use as a modifier.

mouseMoveDeadzone float

The deadzone threshold for mouse movement detection.

mouseWheelDeadzone float

The deadzone threshold for mouse wheel movement detection.

reverseModifier bool

If set to true, the modifier is considered active when the button is not pressed.

Remarks

The reverseModifier parameter is used to prevent an input from being triggered when a modifier combination is pressed. For example, if you have two inputs: LMB + Space and Space, configuring input Space with LMB as a reverse modifier ensures that pressing LMB + Space will not also trigger Space.
